notes.title: Updates have been made based on feedback
notes.notes:
Hi all,
Some people felt that the parts of the game where nothing happened were far too long, and that it made the game boring/dull. Ive taken this feedback into consideration and I have made alterations to drastically reduce the time where in between events. I've manged to cut out about 2.5 - 3 mins of "wait time" altogether. Eg. Where you may have once waited 15 seconds for something to happen, it now only takes 5. 

I have also fixed some shader issues (Eg. a whiskey bottle that was still visible in the dark), along with some other bugs too.

Feedback is always welcome. I hope that having taken feedback into account, the game has improved.

notes.title: For The Best Experience
notes.notes:
Hey guys,
For the best experience : 
- Make sure you are seated at the centre of your defined play area. (In the game you should always be seated in the armchair)
- You can leave down / turn off your controllers as you wont need them for the game.
- Turn up your volume
- Play with the lights turned off. At 2am. Alone.
- Enjoy :)

I hope you get good enjoyment yourselves, but also get some enjoyment scaring family and friends.

Happy Halloween :)
